title: Add a new project (website)
intro: Drop your site's folder or .zip and Rover publishes it with an https address straight away. React/Vue projects are built for you.
intro_hi: अपनी साइट का फ़ोल्डर या .zip छोड़ें, Rover उसे तुरंत https पते पर प्रकाशित कर देता है।

steps.say: Choose Deploy manually (or Import from Git if your code is on GitHub).
Drag your site folder or .zip onto this box, or click browse for a folder. A plain site needs an index.html.
steps.say_hi: अपनी साइट का फ़ोल्डर या zip इस बॉक्स पर छोड़ें।

steps.say: Check the project name. It becomes part of the address.
Click Publish. Rover uploads the files and shows the live address.
Your site is live on its instant https address. Next: add your own domain in the Domain tab.

title: Publish a new version by drag and drop
title_hi: ड्रैग-एंड-ड्रॉप से नया वर्ज़न प्रकाशित करें
intro: Drop the new build on the project. The previous version is kept, so you can roll back in one click.

steps.say: Drag your updated folder or .zip onto this box (or click Browse for a folder).
steps.say_hi: अपडेट किया हुआ फ़ोल्डर या zip इस बॉक्स पर छोड़ें।

steps.say: Your new deploy is at the top of the history. Older ones stay here for one-click roll back.

title: Restore an old version (roll back)
intro: Every deploy is kept. Publishing an older one makes it live again in seconds; the newer one stays in the list.

steps.say: This is the deploy history, newest first. Find the version that worked (the notes and dates help).
Click Publish (roll back) on that version and confirm.
That version is live again. To undo, publish the newer one the same way.

title: Read a project's log
intro: The Logs tab shows what the web server and your site printed. Jiv can read it and explain the important lines.

steps.say: This is the live log. Errors are highlighted. Tip: ask Jiv 'explain the logs of {siteName}' for a plain-English summary.

title: Password-protect a site
intro: Put a simple user name and password in front of the whole site, for staging or client previews.

steps.say: Click Generate for a strong password (or type your own).
Click Save. The next visitor is asked for the password.
